intro: Each category page shows the moment shoppers in that aisle actually look for, then lets you make a still or a clip from one photo.
If you sell in more than one aisle, start with the category of the product in your hand. You can open another category for the next item.

faq.q: Which category should I open first?
faq.a: Open the category of the product in your hand. A mixed catalog does not need a special page. Make one item, then open the next category.

faq.q: Can I start from a phone photo?
faq.a: Yes. Use one clear photo with the whole item visible. Daylight and a plain surface make the color and shape easier to check.

faq.q: How is this different from the template library?
faq.a: This directory groups ideas by what you sell. The template library groups them by layout. Open a category to see the moments, then a template to make that layout.

faq.q: Can one photo become both a still and a clip?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the same photo on the category page and choose a picture template or a clip template. Each job shows its credit cost before it starts.

faq.q: Do these pages tell me the ad size for each channel?
faq.a: Channel sizes live on the platform pages. Category pages focus on the selling moment. A clip can be 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4.

faq.q: Will the file keep my product's color and shape?
faq.a: The file is built from the photo you upload, so start with a picture that already shows the real color and the full shape. Check the result before you post it.

faq.q: What should a new product show first?
faq.a: Show the moment a shopper uses to decide: texture for a jar, fit for a garment, a pour for a drink, or the item turned on for a gadget.

faq.q: Can I run these files as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads can be used commercially and have no watermark. You add the price, any claim, and licensed music after download.
